answers.rationale: The requirement specifies medium voltage switchgear with specific ratings and features, which aligns with the CROWN-ARMV product description for arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear.

The tie breaker sequence of operation and interlock switch requirements are typically part of the control and protection features of medium voltage switchgear, which aligns with the CROWN-ARMV product description.
